about_the_game:
The Archivist is a first-person psychological horror experience inspired by analog horror and VHS aesthetics. You arrive at a decaying wooden house, led there by chance—or by something far more deliberate. Inside, a flickering TV and a scattered collection of VHS tapes are waiting.

Each tape you discover pulls you into a self-contained nightmare: abandoned hospitals filled with shadows, forgotten schools echoing with silence, endless forests that twist on themselves, and liminal spaces that blur reality. Some tapes challenge you with puzzles and strange symbols, others with hostile presences that hunt you. Die within a tape, and you awaken where you first found it, the house whispering with static all around you.

But the house itself is not safe. With every tape you watch, the presence of the Archivist grows stronger. You never see him, only feel his gaze and hear his whispers through the static.

Your only way forward is to watch every tape, collect what lies within, and piece together the story behind this place. Yet the deeper you go, the more uncertain your escape becomes.

  • Explore a haunted house with no weapons, only a flashlight and your wits.

  • Experience seven VHS tape “worlds,” each with unique environments, puzzles, and dangers.

  • Immerse yourself in a blend of realism and VHS glitch aesthetics.

  • Discover fragments of the Archivist’s story through scattered notes and whispers.

You cannot leave until the final tape is played. And when it ends, so does everything you thought you knew.

content_descriptors.notes: Since it's a horror game there might be acts of torture, corpses covered or uncovered, blood and other elements that might be disturbing for some people and is inappropriate for people who are not adults.

name: The Archivist

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5 9th Gen
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1070
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i7 12th Gen
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 3070

short_description: A VHS-themed psychological horror where each tape drags you into a new nightmare. Explore haunted hospitals, schools, forests, and liminal spaces. Solve puzzles, uncover the Archivist’s secrets, and survive a house that grows darker with every tape you watch.
